source_text: Hic ergo ubi dixit Dominus: Si vos Filius liberaverit, vere liberi eritis [n211] , promisit indulgentiam reis, qui peccantes non arbitrii libertatem, sed conscientiam iustitiae perdiderunt. Liberum autem arbitrium et post peccata tam plenum est, quam fuit ante peccata; siquidem ipsius opera fiat ut abdicent plerique occulta dedecoris [n212] , et flagitiorum abiectis sordibus, virtutum comantur insignibus.
pass_a_gloss: Here therefore where the Lord said: If the Son shall have freed you, you will be truly free, he promised indulgence to the guilty, who sinning lost not the liberty of choice, but the conscience of justice. But free choice even after sins is as full as it was before sins; since indeed by its own works it is made that very many abdicate the hidden things of disgrace, and with the filths of shameful deeds thrown away, they are adorned with the insignia of virtues.

lemmas.lexica: LS peccatum=fault, error; Blaise Christian sin
LS arbitrium=judgment, free decision; Blaise liberum arbitrium
LS liber=free; Blaise unde liberum est abstinere

pass_b_english: Here, then, when the Lord said, “If the Son sets you free, you will be truly free” (John 8:36), he promised forgiveness to guilty people who, by sinning, had lost not freedom of choice but a righteous conscience. Free choice remains as complete after sins as it was before sins. Indeed, it is through its action that many renounce the hidden things of shame and, casting away the filth of disgraceful deeds, clothe themselves in the distinctions of virtue (2 Corinthians 4:2).

choices.why: Julian's forensic/moral fault tied to will, not a substance in nature.
Glossary default: arbitrium is the decision-power, not a later Augustinian/Reformation free-will locus.

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied. Pass A is a literal gloss of Augustinus.it Latin of Julian's words only; Augustine's replies in the same locus are excluded.
